name: Lightening Lives
about: An innovation-driven healthcare technology company in Hyderabad. We develop molecular diagnostics for inherited blood and muscle conditions that work from a spot of blood on a card, for hospitals, laboratories and public health programmes.

notice.label: For individuals
notice.body: Looking for a test for yourself or your family? We work with institutions and don't test individuals. Please speak to your doctor or visit your nearest government health facility.

closing.h2: Tell us what your programme needs
closing.body: Tell us the condition you need to test for and where the testing will happen. We will take it from there.
